For fasting participants the instructions were to consume no food or drinks except plain water overnight and for at least8hours before the morning session; controls received no fasting instructions. Study1 has an unknown randomly selected recipient in another cubicle and includes an earlier food-picture craving task. The current text does not reconstruct the exact earlier pictures or food preferences. In Study2, two participants arrived together, their fasting instructions were announced before separate cubicles, and the recipient is that co-participant; no earlier food-picture task was used. The current record supplies the applicable study, endowment, known fasting information, stable demographic attributes and own hunger reported before allocation. Only predict the number of whole cookies given to the recipient, as a single integer from0through the stated endowment.
